The Honeywell Home Y8150A1017 is a fresh air ventilation system kit for homes with forced air heating and cooling. It contains a W8150A1001 ventilation controller, an AT120B1028 24 V transformer and an EARD6TZ TrueZONE fresh air damper with actuator. The system runs on 24 Vac, draws 0.6 A, and is rated for ventilation airflow from 50 to 160 cfm in buildings up to 4,600 square feet. The control opens the damper to bring outdoor air into the duct system.

Key Features

  • Kit: W8150A1001 ventilation controller, AT120B1028 24 V transformer, EARD6TZ TrueZONE damper with actuator
  • 24 Vac; 0.6 A current draw
  • Ventilation airflow capacity 50 to 160 cfm
  • For buildings up to 4,600 sq ft
  • Taupe controller color

Applications

  • Whole-house fresh air ventilation through the forced air duct system
  • Homes up to 4,600 sq ft
  • Ventilation rates between 50 and 160 cfm

Before You Order

  • Required ventilation rate for the house, within 50 to 160 cfm
  • House size: up to 4,600 sq ft
  • Fresh air duct size against the EARD6TZ damper in the kit
  • 24 Vac power location for the included transformer
  • Whether only the W8150 control is needed instead of the full kit

The Resideo AM101-1LF is a lead-free AM-1 Series thermostatic mixing valve with 3/4 in NPT connections. It blends hot and cold water to a mixed outlet temperature adjustable from 70 °F to 145 °F and is used on domestic hot water and hydronic systems. Flow coefficient is 3.8 Cv, minimum flow is 0.5 gpm and maximum operating pressure is 150 psi. The hot inlet range is 120 °F to 180 °F and the cold inlet range is 39 °F to 80 °F.

Key Features

  • Mixed outlet temperature adjustable from 70 °F to 145 °F with a handwheel
  • 3/4 in NPT connections; three-port, straight-through body
  • 3.8 Cv; minimum flow 0.5 gpm
  • Maximum operating pressure 150 psi
  • Check valves on the hot and cold inlets
  • Teflon-coated, nickel-plated brass body with EPDM seals; lead free
  • ASSE 1017 certified; CSA and IAPMO listed

Applications

  • Domestic hot water distribution
  • Nursing homes and public facilities
  • Automatic faucets
  • Industrial and photo processing applications

Before You Order

  • Pipe size and connection type: 3/4 in, NPT threaded
  • Required mixed water temperature within 70 °F to 145 °F
  • Hot supply temperature between 120 °F and 180 °F
  • System pressure no higher than 150 psi
  • Listing required for the application: this valve is ASSE 1017

The Resideo L6006A1145 is a horizontal mount Aquastat controller with SPDT switching for hot water and hydronic heating systems. It can be used for circulator control and as a high limit or low limit. The setting range is 100 °F to 240 °F with a differential adjustable from 5 °F to 30 °F, and the stop is factory-set at 240 °F. Contacts are rated 8 A full load at 120 Vac and 5.1 A at 240 Vac. The copper bulb is 3/8 in x 2-7/8 in on a 3 in capillary.

Key Features

  • SPDT switching for circulator control, high limit or low limit
  • Setting range 100 °F to 240 °F; stop factory-set at 240 °F
  • Differential adjustable from 5 °F to 30 °F
  • 8 A full load / 48 A locked rotor at 120 Vac; 5.1 A / 30.6 A at 240 Vac; millivolt rating 0.25 A at 0.25 to 12 Vdc
  • Horizontal mounting; 3/8 in x 2-7/8 in copper bulb with 3 in capillary
  • Heat-conductive compound included
  • Case 5-5/8 in high x 2 in wide x 2-1/8 in deep; UL component recognized and CSA certified

Applications

  • Circulator control on hot water boilers
  • High limit or low limit control in hydronic heating systems
  • Controls that need both make-on-rise and break-on-rise contacts (SPDT)

Before You Order

  • Part number on the existing Aquastat controller
  • Switching: SPDT, and which terminals the existing wiring uses
  • Temperature range (100 °F to 240 °F) and differential (5 °F to 30 °F)
  • Mounting: horizontal, and the size and insertion length of the existing immersion well
  • Load voltage and current against the contact ratings

The Honeywell Home H6062A1000 is a HumidiPRO digital humidity control for whole-home humidifiers and dehumidifiers. It operates on 24 Vac at 50/60 Hz and mounts on the return duct (recommended) or on a wall. In manual mode the setting is adjustable from 10% to 90% relative humidity; in auto mode it is adjustable from 10% to 60% with a 35% default. The package includes the control, an outdoor sensor and mounting hardware. The control measures 3-7/16 in high x 4-1/2 in wide x 1-5/16 in deep.

Key Features

  • Digital humidity control for whole-home humidifiers or dehumidifiers
  • 24 Vac, 50/60 Hz
  • Manual mode 10% to 90% RH adjustable; auto mode 10% to 60% RH, 35% default
  • Differential 4% to 6% RH; humidity accuracy +/- 5%
  • Return duct mounting (recommended) or wall mounting
  • Outdoor sensor and mounting hardware included
  • Premier White; temperature range -20 °F to 120 °F

Applications

  • Control of whole-home humidifiers
  • Control of whole-home dehumidifiers
  • Duct-mounted or wall-mounted humidity control with an outdoor sensor

Before You Order

  • Equipment to be controlled: whole-home humidifier or dehumidifier with 24 Vac control
  • Mounting location: return duct or wall
  • Wire run for the outdoor sensor
  • Model of the existing humidity control, if replacing one
  • 24 Vac power source at the equipment

The Resideo L4006A1959 is an Aquastat controller for hot water and hydronic systems with a setpoint adjustable from 40 °F to 180 °F and a 2 °F fixed differential. It is used as a high or low limit control and mounts vertically or horizontally. The control is supplied less well, with a well adapter and heat-conductive compound, and has a 3 in capillary. The case measures 5.63 in high x 2 in x 2.13 in.

Key Features

  • Setpoint adjustable from 40 °F to 180 °F
  • 2 °F fixed differential
  • High or low limit control
  • Vertical or horizontal mounting
  • Supplied less well; well adapter and heat-conductive compound included
  • 3 in capillary

Applications

  • Temperature control on hot water and hydronic heating systems

  • Installations with an existing immersion well or a separately purchased well

The Resideo L4006E1117 is a manual reset high limit Aquastat controller for hot water and hydronic heating systems. Its SPST contacts break on temperature rise across a 100 °F to 240 °F setting range. The control mounts horizontally or vertically and is supplied with immersion well 123870A. Contacts are rated 8 A full load at 120 Vac and 5.1 A at 240 Vac. The sensing bulb is 3/8 in x 2-7/8 in copper on a 1-1/2 in capillary, and the insulation depth is 1.5 in.

Key Features

  • High limit control with manual reset
  • Setting range 100 °F to 240 °F
  • SPST switching; contacts break on temperature rise
  • 8 A full load / 48 A locked rotor at 120 Vac; 5.1 A / 30.6 A at 240 Vac
  • Immersion well 123870A included; 1.5 in insulation depth
  • 3/8 in x 2-7/8 in copper bulb with 1-1/2 in capillary; horizontal or vertical mounting
  • UL component recognized, CSA certified and AGA certified

Applications

  • High limit protection on hot water boilers
  • Hydronic heating systems that require a manual reset limit
  • Boiler tappings that take the included immersion well

Before You Order

  • Part number on the existing Aquastat controller
  • Function: manual reset high limit, SPST break on rise
  • Boiler tapping size against the spud of the included well 123870A
  • Insulation depth of the existing well: 1.5 in
  • Load voltage and current against the contact ratings
